dataQuality: Duplicate plot ids on this map (same id drawn 10 times as separate shapes; they share one status and one booking): B-158 x2, B-113 x2, B-101 x2, B-153 x2, B-144 x2, B-133b x2, B-138 x2, B-128 x2, D-2 x2, D-1 x2. Each shape has a unique 'key' (id~2 for the second copy). Owner/sales team must confirm which shape is the real plot.
Shapes whose visible label differs from the booking id: B-159a shows "B-159", B-159b shows "B-159".
Fixed-colour shapes that never show status in the old map: D-2, D-1 (pink triangles beside the mall; they reuse the ids D-1/D-2 of the small D-block plots).
The big pink 'D-3' block at the bottom (x 875-955, y 1023-1065) is not clickable; a different, clickable D-3 exists in the D block.

Backend rows for this colony on 2026-10-12: B-3 SOLD, C-1 RESERVED, D-3 / B-138 / B-159 / B-139 / B-29B AVAILABLE (with some dimensions/areas). Everything else is not in the database and renders AVAILABLE.
